name: Microsoft Viva Glint
summary: Viva Glint runs engagement, onboarding and exit surveys for large organizations and reports results by team and organization with heat maps. Microsoft lists it at $2.00 per user per month, billed yearly, with a 50-seat minimum and an annual subscription that renews automatically.

facts.text: Glint offers confidential and identifiable surveys. For a survey to be confidential, the minimum number of responses is three, and the default confidentiality statement mentions groups of five or more respondents.
Write-in comments are reported verbatim only if at least 10 people respond to a question, under the default statement.
Microsoft states a 50-seat license minimum to use Viva Glint.
Viva Glint results are broken down by team and organization, with trends and heat maps available when a survey closes.

plans.name: Viva Glint
plans.notes: Paid yearly on an annual commitment. 50-seat minimum

plans.name: Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback

hiddenCosts: The Viva Insights integration needs a Viva Insights license, and Copilot adoption surveys need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

contract.cancellation: Microsoft says the annual subscription auto renews and can be cancelled at any time in the Microsoft 365 admin center, though some subscriptions may carry a cancellation fee.
